incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: High 5xx rate on /v1/generate across prod-eu. Current 5xx rate 4.8% (baseline 0.1%). Paging Lin (oncall). See: https://dashboard.redwood/prod-eu/errors/2061209876

Lin (oncall): I'm on it, looking at dashboard now. can someone grab logs for kv-cache-* and model-host errors?

Ari SRE: grabbing logs, give me 2m. querying logs: `env:prod region:eu service:inference level:error "kv cache eviction"` -> huge tail of "kv-cache-eviction" + OOM entries.

Samir: is this correlated with a deploy? checks deploy bot -> OpsRunbot: deploy-prod/2026-03-15T01:12:34 to eu-inference

Lin (oncall): deploy looks green. I'm rolling a quick mitigation: suppress paging for the noisy 5xx rule and route to slack only while we investigate. @Ari can you propose query filters to drop health-check noise?

Ari SRE: propose change. old rule (log-based):
```
index=prod logs | where path =~ "/v1/generate" and level=="error" and status >= 500
```
new rule suggestion (exclude probes + cold-start noise):
```
index=prod logs | where path =~ "/v1/generate" and level=="error" and status >= 500
  | where message !~ /healthcheck|probe|kube-probe/
  | where not(match(message, "kv-cache-eviction.*cold-start"))
```
Also add signature `kv-cache-eviction-oom` to match the common stack trace snippet.

Dana (CustomerSuccess): partial customer impact: we saw elevated errors for a handful of accounts in eu-west-1, CS alerted 3 customers, none reported data loss but increased latency.

Lin (oncall): ok executing suppression window: `/alerts suppress 2061209876 --duration 2h --notes "suppress noisy paging while we tune rule, route to #incidents only"`

OpsRunbot: suppression created by Lin for alert 2061209876 for 2h. :white_check_mark:

Samir: I'm rolling a canary config change: updating alert query in staging then prod with Ari's filters. will post diffs.

Samir: diff:
```
-where message not like "%kube-probe%"
+| where message !~ /kube-probe|healthcheck|probe/
+| where not(match(message, "kv-cache-eviction.*oom"))
```

Ari SRE: added a temporary dashboard panel: "5xx by host (filtered)" and pinned to incident channel. link: https://dash.redwood/p/5xx-eu/2061209876

Lin (oncall): running `kubectl describe pod` on a few hosts, saw memory pressure on inference-node-7, OOMKilled count 3.

Ari SRE: Looks like a memory regression during the deploy causing cache evictions. plan: a) tune rule to reduce noise b) add signature c) revert or roll forward a small fix to reduce memory pressure.

Dana (CustomerSuccess): marking customer impact as "degraded" in incident doc. Notifying affected customers with status update v1.

Lin (oncall): leaving a handoff note for morning oncall: keep suppression active until we confirm the fix or further morning analysis. created post-incident ticket: PI-3821.

Samir: will push alert query change to prod in 10 min. monitoring for false negatives.

OpsRunbot: prod config change applied by Samir at 2061210476. :gear:

Lin (oncall): update: after query change, alert volume down 95% and paging stopped. current 5xx rate back to 0.3%.

Ari SRE: follow-up actions added to PI-3821: add log signature `kv-cache-eviction-oom`, create targeted dashboard for cache metrics, add a guard to deploy pipeline to block when memory alloc increases >10%.

Dana (CustomerSuccess): scheduling postmortem with customer-facing summary draft. I'll share in #customer-updates for review.

Lin (oncall): handing off to @Ari for overnight watch; I'll be offline. Handoff notes: suppression until 2061217076, PI ticket, dashboard link, affected customers list in incident doc. :handshake:

Ari SRE: acknowledged, I'll monitor for 4 hours and call if any regression. tagging @oncall-rotations for visibility.

incident-bot: Incident created incident/PI-3821 at https://incidents.redwood/PI-3821 by Lin. Severity: P2. Status: monitoring.

Lin (oncall): thanks team. please add any follow-ups here and we'll close the loop in the postmortem.

Samir: leaving a short note: added regex signature and a unit test for log parser to avoid future misses. :memo:

Ari SRE: quick note to ops: we'll schedule a capacity bump for eu hosts tomorrow morning if the memory regression reproduces.:calendar:
